raw.title: Tao Te Ching
raw.extract: The Tao Te Ching or Dào Dé Jīng, also known simply as the Laozi, is an ancient Chinese classic text traditionally attributed to the sage Laozi. It is regarded as the foundational Taoist text alongside the Zhuangzi. Central to both philosophical and religious Taoism, it has been "profoundly influential" more broadly in Chinese culture, art and medicine.
